app.notes: Allsky's WebUI is plain PHP and runs on the Pi under lighttpd. Here mise pins a static PHP 8.3 CLI (NativePHP build with session/gd/sqlite3/zip) and a static ffmpeg, which is used only for seeding. setup_home.sh builds an 'installed Allsky' tree at .ui-capture/home/allsky (ALLSKY_HOME): code is symlinked into this checkout, while config/, images/, tmp/ and logs/ are local. It generates variables.json the way install.sh does and runs createAllskyOptions.php. seed/seed.php (with gen_images.php, gen_database.php, gen_videos.php and gen_logs.php) then writes the data of an established install: an RPi HQ camera on a Pi 5 in Westcliffe, Colorado (Wet Mountain Valley dark-sky site), owned by Maren Okafor. That covers fully configured settings (location, lens, crop, rotation, overlays, local and remote website), WebUI login enabled, and 14 nights (Nov 3-16, 2026) of images. Each night has ~100 day and night frames with thumbnails, a keogram, startrails and an MP4 timelapse with video thumbnail. Clear, cloudy and moonlit nights are mixed, plus meteor captures with marked copies and metadata on clear nights, tonight's in-progress folder and a mini-timelapse. There is a SQLite database (config/myFiles/allsky.db) with ~1,400 image rows (exposure, gain, sensor temperature, mean), star counts, clear-sky flags, meteor counts, Pi CPU temperature and memory every 10 minutes, and startrails statistics, all feeding the Chart Manager. Also seeded: two System Messages (a failed startrails upload and a dew-heater note), three earlier support logs, and Allsky/periodic/lighttpd logs. start.sh runs everything in the foreground on $PORT (default 4481). If home/allsky/.seeded is missing it rebuilds from scratch first (~6 minutes, all local). Sign in at /index.php?page=login with admin / Westcliffe-Skies-2026. Main areas (left menu): Live View, Images (per-day folders; inside a day, the image grid plus Timelapse/Keogram/Startrails/Meteors), Allsky Settings (camera settings form), Editor (config file editor), Overlay Editor, Module Manager (post-processing flows), Chart Manager, LAN/WLAN dashboards, Wi-Fi (sparse on macOS, since it needs /usr/sbin/ip, iw and nmcli), System (status, uptime, CPU/memory, log viewer, backups), Change Password, Getting Support. Data is dated relative to when the seed ran (Nov 17, 2026). Charts default to recent time ranges, so if opened much later, widen the range or delete home/allsky/.seeded to reseed.
